subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets (line, bar, area, sparkline, gauge)

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor chart widgets as trusted bundled dashboard builtins once the Wave 1 dashboard surface is settled?
rationale: The requested chart primitives are useful and fit the roadmap, but the dashboard substrate is not on main and bundled trusted widgets are a product/security boundary that automation should not decide.

options.title: Sponsor after Wave 1
options.body: Accept the chart-widget direction only after the dashboard plugin/control plane lands or is replaced, then implement charts in that owner boundary with real browser proof.

options.title: Defer to widget SDK or ClawHub
options.body: Keep charts outside bundled core until a widget SDK or external plugin path can carry them without expanding the default dashboard surface.

options.title: Pause the dashboard roadmap
options.body: Leave this issue open but inactive if maintainers are not ready to accept the modular dashboard product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after Wave 1
recommendation.body: Accept the chart-widget direction only after the dashboard plugin/control plane lands or is replaced, then implement charts in that owner boundary with real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main owner signal for the bundled Control UI plugin-tab seam that this dashboard work reuses.
